name: Stone Golem
languages: Understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Crushing Shove.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.

Actions.name: Force Bolt
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +9, range 120 ft. 22 (4d10) Force damage.

Actions.name: Crushing Shove
Actions.text: *Strength Saving Throw:* DC 17, one creature within 5 feet. *Failure:* The target is pushed up to 15 feet away from the golem and has the Prone condition.

Traits.name: Relentless Pursuit
Traits.text: While the golem is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the golem's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Bonus Actions.name: Slow (Recharge 5-6)
Bonus Actions.text: The golem casts the *Slow* spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).

lore: Carved by a penniless order as a saint who mourns the world's sins, the statue was animated by the depth of that collective grief and now walks the roads looking for a wound worth weeping over — and a congregation worth crushing into the ground.

generation.userConcept: Stone Golem — carved as a weeping saint

clauses.text: Stone Golem — carved as a weeping saint

generation.cite: composition after Fire Giant (CR 9) — the giant ladder continues

immunities: Poison, Psychic; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
